release.content: pubdeploy 0.4.1 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit 467e8043751b24c14dc1225cba19b3c6e46f0d12 with these changes.

rows: walk --fulfil says on stderr how each need it acted on ended (state, what it found, the fulfil's failure and the fix), so the engine's Fulfil page, which runs it with --json, shows why a need is still not ready

k8s.jwks: a file that pins the cluster's service-account signing keys (Workload Identity providers, storage's principals) holds exactly the keys kubectl get --raw /openid/v1/jwks gives; drift names each key added, gone or changed

release.scope: the published release v0.4.1 of pubdeploy
